page.label: Architecture
page.title:
How the stack
fits together.
page.description: An interactive map of agentic-dev-stack: the lead plans, cheap and free models execute, an independent reviewer checks, and a token-economy layer wraps it all.

section.label: Architecture
section.title:
The lead plans.
The rest build.
section.intro: An expensive model decides, cheap and free models do the volume, and an independent reviewer checks the diff. Scroll to watch it assemble, then click any part.

figure.caption: The agentic-dev-stack architecture: you talk to a lead model, which delegates to native subagents and to alethe, which runs workers in isolated worktrees. A curator keeps the free models healthy, Hermes reports to your phone, and a token-economy layer wraps everything.
figure.alt: Diagram of agentic-dev-stack: you, the lead (Opus), a delegation layer of native subagents and alethe, workers in isolated worktrees, the self-healing free models, Hermes, and the token-economy layer.

explorer.label: Interactive architecture diagram. Each part is a button that opens its details.

stages.spec: Spec: you and the lead write down what and why.
stages.tasks: Tasks: the lead splits the work into units and hands them to delegation.
stages.builders: Three builders work in parallel, each in its own worktree.
stages.review: The diffs go to the independent reviewer.
stages.fail: Review fails once. The diff goes back to the builder.
stages.retry: The builder fixes the diff and sends it again.

meter.label: Tokens, relative
meter.hint: Bars are relative and illustrative, not measured. Only the RTK range comes from the docs.

curator.title: The curator drops dead models
curator.intro: Runs {times} times a day. It probes each candidate with a chat and a tool call, then rewrites the combo that 9Router serves.
curator.illustrative: Illustrative results: the 410 case is real, the latencies are made up for the demo.
curator.statusProbe: Probing the candidate models one by one.
curator.statusDrop: A model answered 410 Gone and is dropped. The combo is rewritten.
curator.statusDone: Done. The combo now lists only healthy models and 9Router never stopped serving.

teaser.label: The lead plans and fans work out to scout, builder and reviewer.
